notes: DRAFT for C14 (Jay via Manager). Some Guardians do a full form shift mid-fight: they glow for about 1 second, then come back in a new form. The shift happens at the same moment as that Guardian's 33% phase change, so the new form brings the last phase's attacks (no new attacks). Each shift shows the shadow letting go a little, so it reads hopeful, not scarier. Faith text stays out (faithOverlayKey only). newForm names are proposals. Lamp Keeper, Hearth Cook, River Watcher, Ember Knight, Echo Mask and Root Keeper do not shift (see guardian-form-shifts.md).

glowRule.tell: Guardian glows white-gold with a soft chime, then pops into the new form.

shifts.loreReason: The worry stones start to fall off. Underneath, a smaller giant of round, mossy stones is trying to be brave.
shifts.artistBrief: Shorter, rounder pile of smooth gray-green stones with moss tufts and one warm glowing crack in the middle like a heart. Big friendly eyes, no mouth. Loose pebbles bounce around its feet.

shifts.loreReason: Its roots find the sun. The thorns drop away, and yellow flowers open all over its vines.
shifts.artistBrief: Same vine shape, but thorns are gone and replaced by big yellow sun-flowers and leaves. Softer green, a sunny glow at the center. Plant shape, no human face; two flower eyes.
shifts.senseiLine: Look. It is reaching for the sun.

shifts.loreReason: The storm runs out of shouting. It shrinks into one round cloud, and a little calm blue sky peeks through.
shifts.artistBrief: A single round puffy storm cloud, smaller than before, with a patch of blue sky and one star showing in its middle. Small sparks crackle on the edges. Two soft eyes in the cloud, no arms or body.
shifts.senseiLine: Listen. The calm is getting louder.

shifts.loreReason: The storm clouds pull in tight around the last light. It shines through the cracks, showing there is still hope inside.
shifts.artistBrief: A tall, swirling storm cloud shaped like a lantern, with warm gold light shining out through cracks. The traveler stays hidden inside; show no person, face or body. Only the glow and two small light-eyes.
shifts.senseiLine: The light is still there. Go to them.
shifts.formPlaceholderNote: The Black belt kata form stays a PLACEHOLDER (formPlaceholder: true in the boss file). newForm here is the visual shape only, not the kata form.
